name: Haisha
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood dental clinic, Nikoniko Shika: a new checkup-reservation notice, a first day helping at the clinic, a checkup booking guide, a trial tooth-brushing consultation corner notice, a new-hire training plan comparison, a column about learning from a regular patient's change in manner, a lesson teaching a new kouhai how to sterilize instruments safely, an explainer on why staff consultation is still needed in the online-booking era, a custom mouthguard service application guide, a column on how online reservations changed front-desk reception work, a new rule for busy-season (summer vacation) checkup bookings, a column on the meaning of a veteran hygienist's skill for sensing a patient's change in condition, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elementary school's dental health program. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
